question: In March 2020, Muhyiddin Yassin took over as the Prime Minister of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malaysia**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Muhyiddin Yassin** became the **eighth prime minister** of Malaysia who served from March 2020 to August 2021.
 
• He along with his cabinet of ministers resigned after losing majority.
 
• His tenure of** 17 months** is the shortest stint of Malaysian leader.
 
• He has been appointed as the **caretaker PM** until a new PM is selected.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Malaysia:**__

 __
 
• **​**__Current Prime Minister of Malaysia-** Ismail Sabri Yaakob** 

 
 
• Currency-** Malaysian Ringgit.**
 
• Capital- **Kuala Lumpur.**
